Netanyahu seeks Israeli arms independence from US

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has stated that Israel should reduce its reliance on the United States for arms. This call for greater self-sufficiency in military hardware comes as a significant policy statement regarding the nation's defense strategy and its relationship with its primary military supplier.
